messages:
alex: Heads-up — our sampleapp onboarding flow is triggering big request bursts to the API when prefetch + pagination hit auth refresh. Seen in staging after the new paginator change.
maya: ugh, can you paste the logs?
alex: sure
alex: ```
2026-02-14T13:02:11Z ERROR fetchPage 429 Too Many Requests - cooldown
2026-02-14T13:02:11Z INFO retrying token_refresh -> new token
2026-02-14T13:02:12Z WARN prefetch worker spawn=6 pending=18
2026-02-14T13:02:12Z ERROR request failed 429 route=/v1/generate sequence=3
``` 
alex: tl;dr: prefetch spawns workers 1..N and when token refresh happens they all retry immediately -> tight retry storm -> 429 cascade.
liam: Which SDK? py/js parity?
alex: reproduces in js-sdk (sampleapp uses js) and py for E2E tests. But defaults differ: js prefetch concurrency=6, py=3.
maya: that's a problem — we want consistent defaults + backoff behavior. Did we add jitter to refresh retries?
sam: onboard-bot reported a spike at 13:02:10: `onboard-bot: prefetch-concurrency=6` and then 75% 429 rate across sessions.
liam: I can reproduce locally. Steps: 1) run sampleapp with prefetch=6, 2) simulate token expiry mid-stream (short-lived test token), 3) trigger pagination heavy list -> all workers hit refresh and retry. Without jitter they all retry at the same ms.
maya: Proposed quick fixes:
- Add randomized jitter to token refresh retry (expo backoff + jitter)
- Cap prefetch concurrency default to 2 for onboarding sampleapp
- Add client-side leaky-bucket or minimal token-bucket limiter around refresh/critical path
- Update SDK docs and sampleapp README
alex: I pushed a tiny repro into the sampleapp branch `onboard/prefetch-burst` with a toggle for prefetch.
alex: https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp/compare/onboard/prefetch-burst
liam: I'll take the SDK change for JS: add jitter to refresh and make concurrency default=3 (less aggressive). I'll open a PR today.
maya: I'll update docs + the onboarding quickstart to recommend prefetch<=2 for new users; also add a note about token lifetime and recommend server-side refresh if possible.
sam: QA: can we add a smoke test that simulates token rotation and asserts no >50 rps spike per session? If so, put it in CI for sampleapp.
liam: yes, I'll add a unit that monkeypatches the token provider and asserts backoff applied.
alex: action items: liam -> js-sdk PR; maya -> docs + sampleapp README tweak; sam -> CI smoke test; alex -> cleanup repro branch and attach logs to the issue.
maya: assigning: @liam, @maya, @sam, @alex. ETA EOD tomorrow for initial PRs? :hourglass:
liam: working on it, will ping when draft PR up :thumbsup:
alex: thanks all. leaving the repro running for a bit, will post traces if the 429 pattern changes.
onboard-bot: NOTE: created issue RED-5782 "sampleapp prefetch refresh storm" and linked thread.
maya: perfect — we'll track in RED-5782. If anyone sees related regressions in Dedicated customers, flag infra immediately.
liam: quick question: should we change SDK defaults now or only sampleapp? Risky to change defaults mid-release.
maya: start with sampleapp + docs, then propose SDK default change in minor semver with clear changelog. Good call.
alex: cool, closing thread for now. ping here when PRs land. :rocket:
